title: Gen AI Dev.
description:
Gen AI Dev. ( Work from Office )

We are hiring two Gen AI Dev. to integrate intelligent AI capabilities into a live SaaS platform serving customers and businesses across Europe. You’ll use TypeScript throughout the stack to connect large language models and generative AI systems with real-world product features. Your responsibilities will include crafting effective prompts, implementing structured outputs, developing reliable evaluations and automated tests, and ensuring AI-generated recommendations operate within clearly defined business rules and safeguards. This is a hands-on product engineering position focused on building and shipping practical AI solutions rather than conducting research or training models. We actively use AI coding agents in our daily development workflow and expect you to incorporate them into yours as well. This opportunity is ideal for engineers with 2–5 years of professional experience who are excited to build reliable, AI-powered products.

***What You’ll Do***

* **AI Feature Development:** Build end-to-end features powered by large language models, covering prompt design, structured responses, API integration, user interfaces, and automated testing.
* **Generative Media Integration:** Implement image-generation and image-editing models, evaluating their performance in terms of quality, response time, and cost per output.
* **Business Logic and Safeguards:** Ensure AI-generated results are treated as suggestions and pass through deterministic validation and business rules before being presented to users.
* **Evaluation and Testing:** Create evaluation datasets and automated testing workflows to objectively measure the impact of changes to prompts and models.
* **Data Integration:** Import, transform, map, and validate structured data from external partners, leveraging AI to reduce manual effort wherever practical.
* **Configuration Tools:** Develop intuitive tools that enable non-technical administrators to manage and customize business rules safely.
* **Production Reliability:** Implement logging and monitoring for resource-intensive AI operations, investigate production issues, and deliver effective fixes.
* **AI-Powered Development:** Use AI coding assistants such as Claude Code, Cursor, or similar tools as part of your daily workflow, while maintaining strong testing practices and ensuring code quality and reliability.

***What We’re Looking For***

* **Professional Experience:** 2–5 years of software engineering experience, including hands-on experience delivering at least one LLM-powered feature to a production environment.
* **Programming Skills:** Strong proficiency in TypeScript and Node.js, with the ability to write and work with SQL confidently.
* **LLM Engineering:** Practical experience with OpenAI or Anthropic APIs, prompt design, structured outputs, schema validation tools such as Zod, and function or tool calling.
* **Testing and Evaluation:** Ability to develop automated tests and evaluation frameworks for applications that rely on non-deterministic AI model outputs.
* **Data Engineering:** Familiarity with PostgreSQL, data modelling, and the challenges of processing, cleaning, and validating inconsistent data from external sources.
* **AI-Assisted Coding:** Regular, hands-on experience with AI coding agents, along with the technical judgement to review, validate, and improve their generated code.
* **Additional Skills:** Experience with image-generation APIs, vector databases and search using pgvector, background job processing with Redis or BullMQ, Next.js and React, Three.js, Python for evaluation scripts, or proficiency in German would be an advantage

**About iRONic Ventures**

iRONic Ventures is a Germany-based venture group focused on building AI-first businesses from the ground up. We invest our own capital in AI startups, including TAIWA, Nexora AI, and Hurraay, develop and operate our own products, and deliver fixed-fee AI solutions for startups across Europe. After operating in Germany since 2023, we are expanding our presence by establishing a new office in Berlin and another in Kochi, India. We are now looking for talented engineers to join our growing teams and help build the next generation of AI-powered products.

* **Engineers Who Build and Invest:** We combine technical expertise with an investment mindset. Our product decisions are driven by people who understand the code and actively contribute to building our products.
* **AI-Native Development:** AI coding agents, automated testing, and rapid release cycles are integral to how we work. These practices are embedded in our engineering culture rather than treated as experiments.
* **Diverse Engineering Challenges:** Contribute to multiple codebases across new ventures, internal products, and client projects, gaining exposure to different technologies, business models, and product challenges.
* **An Opportunity to Build in Kochi:** Become one of the founding engineers at our Kochi office, help establish the local team's culture and workflows, and collaborate closely with colleagues in Berlin.
* **European Standards of Quality:** Build reliable, production-ready solutions for customers in Germany and across Europe, with privacy, multilingual support, and dependable performance considered essential from the very beginning.

**Why Join iRONic Ventures?**

* **Real-World Impact:** Develop and launch AI-powered features in a live SaaS product used by real customers, moving beyond prototypes to deliver practical solutions.
* **AI-First Engineering Culture:** Work with modern AI coding agents, automated testing, and rapid development cycles as an integral part of your everyday workflow.
* **Ownership and Impact:** Join a lean, collaborative team where you take responsibility for your work and have a direct influence on the product’s growth and success.
* **Learn from Experienced Leaders:** Collaborate closely with the founders and senior engineers, gain hands-on experience, and accelerate your professional development.

Pay: From ₹400,000.00 per year

Ability to commute/relocate:

* Kochi, Kerala: Reliably commute or planning to relocate before starting work (Required)

Experience:

* Node.js: 2 years (Required)

title: Banking App support engineer
description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

**The Role**

Application Support engineer to provide L1/L2 24/7 banking and payments application support experience in banking domain, analyze, debug & resolve production issues. Strong Experience with SQL, Linux, Oracle, IIS, Devops, API, troubleshooting, application monitoring, log checking, Incident management & resolution, fine tuning, root cause analysis, scripting and automation skills

Your future at Kyndryl
  
Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career, from Junior System Administrator to Architect. We have opportunities for Cloud Hyperscale's that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. One of the benefits of Kyndryl is that we work with clients in a variety of industries, from banking to retail. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here.

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.

**Required Technical and Professional Expertise** :

* 5 to 10 years experience in providing L1/L2 application support for payment systems UPI, NEFT/RTGS, ATM, DCMS, 42CS, Getepay and Fraud risk management applications
* Should have a very good understanding of Recon, batch processes, Core banking systems etc
* Should have knowledge on s like Flexcube Retail (FCR) India banking system, Onboarding Systems, Lending, Internet Banking, Mobile Banking, Payments, CRM etc
* Should have good exposure to customer onboarding process, KYC, API integration, workflows etc
* Should be able to write complex SQL queries, mapping tables from source to target systems
* Knowledge in banking domain, especially for India specific requirements.
* Strong technical acumen & deep working knowledge of Agile Methods, Service Architecture and Integration
* Strong ability to influence, collaborate and build relationships with key stakeholders, vendors, and cross-functional teams
* **Job location:** Thrissur/Cochin/Kerala

**Preferred Technical and Professional Experience**

* Software Engineering Life Cycle deliverables for banking projects
* Work closely with the business and IT teams to analyse business requirements, analyse and resolve production issues, root cause analysis, identify automation scope etc
* SQL, Linux, Oracle, IIS, Devops, API, troubleshooting, application monitoring, log checking, Incident management & resolution
* Experience in using and implementing DevSecOps processes

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  
  
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  
  
We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  
  
We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

**Get Referred!**

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

-------------------


Requisition ID: 1744156

And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

  


**Job Description**



I\&O Platform Infrastructure Application Performance Management and Logging (ELK) SME



Assistant Director \| Enterprise Technology

  


**The opportunity**



In a plan to strengthen and extend our footprint in EY Enterprise Technology, we are looking for a proven Application Performance Management (APM) and Logging SME to support and evolve EY's monitoring and observability platforms globally. The role will provide engineering leadership, operational support, automation and lifecycle management for the firm's APM tooling and the ELK (Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana) stack. The successful candidate will work with cutting\-edge observability technologies, driving platform maturity, operational excellence and engineering innovation across EY's global infrastructure estate.

  


**Your key responsibilities**



The I\&O Platform Infrastructure APM and Logging SME provides technical leadership and engineering of complex nature for the firm's application performance monitoring and centralized logging platforms. This professional applies knowledge of APM solutions, the ELK stack, log management, metrics pipelines and distributed tracing to support enterprise\-scale workloads and enable rapid incident response.

  



The role requires deep knowledge of the firm's infrastructure monitoring landscape to implement platform enhancements, lifecycle management activities, onboarding programs, security initiatives and operational improvements. The SME will serve as the subject matter authority for APM and logging platforms, partnering with application teams, infrastructure engineers and security stakeholders across global locations to ensure observability coverage, data quality and platform reliability.

  


**Skills and attributes for success**


* Strong experience designing, deploying and administering ELK stack (Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana) at enterprise scale.
* Deep knowledge of APM tooling (e.g., Dynatrace, AppDynamics, Elastic APM, New Relic or equivalent).
* Experience architecting centralized logging solutions and log aggregation pipelines.
* Strong understanding of metrics, traces and logs as the three pillars of observability.
* Experience with Elasticsearch cluster management, index lifecycle management (ILM) and snapshot/restore.
* Knowledge of Logstash pipeline development and Beats (Filebeat, Metricbeat, Winlogbeat) deployment.
* Experience building Kibana dashboards, visualizations and alerting rules.
* Experience with log parsing, field extraction, grok patterns and data enrichment.
* Knowledge of distributed tracing frameworks and instrumentation approaches.
* Strong scripting and automation skills, including:
	+ Python
	+ PowerShell
	+ Bash / Shell scripting
* Experience integrating monitoring platforms with ITSM tooling (e.g., ServiceNow).
* Ability to produce high\-quality technical documentation, runbooks and operational procedures.
* Strong working knowledge of DevOps, Agile, Kanban, SCRUM and ITIL frameworks.
* Ability to work effectively with clients, management and global engineering teams across multiple time zones.

  


**To qualify for the role, you must have experience with**


* ELK stack (Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana) — enterprise\-scale deployment and administration. 7\+ years.
* APM platform engineering and administration (Dynatrace, AppDynamics, Elastic APM or equivalent). 7\+ years.
* Centralized logging architecture design and operations. 7\+ years.
* Elasticsearch cluster management, performance tuning and capacity planning. 7\+ years.
* Logstash pipeline development and Beats agent fleet management. 5–7 years.

* ITIL v4 Foundation certification (exclusionary).
* Experience with OpenTelemetry (OTel) standards and collector configuration.
* Experience with Elastic Cloud or Elastic Cloud on Kubernetes (ECK).
* Familiarity with cloud\-native logging solutions (Azure Monitor, AWS CloudWatch, GCP Cloud Logging).
* Experience operating in a managed service or large enterprise shared services environment.

  


**What we look for**



An experienced and technically deep observability engineer and leader to help build, operate and modernize EY's APM and centralized logging platforms. We are looking for an individual with proven expertise in ELK stack engineering, strong APM platform knowledge, a passion for operational excellence and automation, and the ability to serve as the technical authority for monitoring and observability across EY's global infrastructure estate.

**Job description**
-------------------


Requisition ID: 1744229
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

  



EndPoint Infrastructure Patching \& Vulnerability Management Administrator


**Role Title**


EndPoint Infrastructure Patching \& Vulnerability Management Administrator

  

**Function / Portfolio**

Digital Workplace Enablement Services (DWES) – EndPoint Management

  

**Scope**



Patching \& vulnerability remediation of the \~450 on\-prem SCCM/APPPROXY infrastructure servers (CAS, Primary Sites, SQL site databases and supporting server roles)

  



**Job Description Summary**



Maintain and secure the Endpoint Management infrastructure (approximately 450 SCCM and AppProxy servers) by ensuring systems remain patched, hardened, and free of known vulnerabilities. Own the end\-to\-end server patching and remediation lifecycle, including monitoring, validation, deployment coordination, post\-patch verification, and driving vulnerability findings to closure.



The successful candidate will operate the patching lifecycle end to end: monitoring for released fixes, validating them, sequencing and executing patching in coordination with the SCCM and Approxy engineering team, restarting/validating servers, and driving vulnerability findings to closure.



The estate is split across non\-production and production environments and includes the Central Administration Site (CAS), Primary Sites and their SQL site databases, which are the true single point of failure for a site. Work is executed against an accelerated cadence and, when required, under an Emergency/Zero\-Day change model. The role is hands\-on, evidence\-driven and governed by EY change management (RFC / eCAB).

  

**Key Responsibilities**



**Server Patching \& Maintenance**


* Execute monthly, accelerated and emergency patching across the \~450 SCCM/AppProxy servers (non\-production first, then production), following the confirmed environment sequence.
* Sequence patching correctly so Windows/SQL work completes before SCCM/APPPROXY patching in each environment; perform and validate server restarts within the agreed windows.
* Apply Microsoft SCCM/APPPROXY hotfixes and SQL Server cumulative updates (CU/GDR) as prerequisites for a healthy SCCM/APPPROXY platform, coordinating carefully around SQL site databases to avoid taking a whole site down.
* Support High\-Availability failover patching (patch passive node/SQL replica, switch active/passive, patch former active) to minimize outage windows.

  


**Vulnerability Management \& Remediation**


* Own the remediation of vulnerabilities flagged against the SCCM/APPPROXY server estate (e.g. GVM / scanner findings from tools such as Qualys / Tenable), tracking each item to closure within SLA.
* Triage and prioritize findings by criticality (CVSS), separating in\-scope SCCM/APPPROXY/SQL items from those owned by other teams and re\-assigning out\-of\-scope items correctly (accurate CMDB ownership).
* Validate that deployed fixes actually mitigate the reported vulnerability, remove flagged/unnecessary software, and capture evidence for audit and closure.
* Maintain and report remediation status, backlog reduction and platform health metrics to the SCCM/APPPROXY lead and stakeholders.

  


**Coordination, Change \& War Room Operations**


* Liaise daily with the core SCCM/APPPROXY engineering team, SQL/DBA, platform, and service management to plan and execute patch windows.
* Raise and manage changes through EY change management (RFC / eCAB), including emergency/zero\-day changes, respecting change freezes and approvals.
* Provide War Room coverage during patch surges and zero\-day events: readiness checks, live execution, validation, rollback if thresholds are exceeded, and clear stakeholder communication.
* Produce concise, evidence\-based status updates and closure reports for leadership.

  


**Required Skills \& Experience**


* Hands\-on experience administering and patching SCCM/APPPROXY server infrastructure (CAS, Primary Sites, site system roles) in a large enterprise estate.
* Strong Windows Server administration skills (multi\-domain Active Directory) including patching, restart sequencing and post\-patch validation.
* Working knowledge of SQL Server as an SCCM/APPPROXY prerequisite — applying CU/GDR updates and understanding site\-database criticality and Always On / HA concepts.
* Solid understanding of enterprise change management (RFC / CAB / eCAB) and evidence/audit discipline.
* Ability to work under pressure in a War Room / on\-call model across accelerated and emergency patch cycles.

  


**Out of Scope**



To keep the role focused, the following are explicitly not the primary responsibility of this position:


* Day\-to\-day administration of the SCCM/APPPROXY application layer — application packaging/deployment, collections/targeting, task sequences, client health and end\-user device compliance.
* Operating\-system patching governance owned by other platform teams (the role executes/sequences server patching but does not own OS patch policy).
